relationships.subject: JAK/STAT pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: JAK-STAT pathway promotes ADAMTS- and MMP-mediated ECM degradation and reduces type II collagen expression in chondrocytes

relationships.subject: IL-6
relationships.evidence_quote: IL-6 can also activate the M1 phenotype of macrophages via the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway

relationships.subject: JAK2/STAT3 pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: JAK2/STAT3 can stimulate the nuclear translocation of NF-κBp65, up regulate NF-κB pathway, trigger the expression of RANKL, and increasing the expression of MMP-3 and MMP-9 in arthritis cartilage

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: TNF-α can mediate the activation of matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs)

key_findings: Review: JAK/STAT signaling, driven by IL-6 and other cytokines, promotes MMP/ADAMTS-mediated ECM degradation in OA chondrocytes.
SOCS proteins provide negative feedback on JAK/STAT and are proposed therapeutic targets.
